approach.method_basis: The Parent evolves fresh molecular graphs from the current session’s accepted scores. Its fixed count-fingerprint Student-t process integrates a response-dependent common covariance scale while retaining the original Gaussian-process predictive mean. Ten independent joint function draws each nominate one purchase, with the original top-forty mean-rank eligibility mask after three non-improving batches. Accepted scores update the full training archive, greedy survivor population and quantile-based breeder.
approach.novelty: Keep that predictive law and eligibility rule, but choose the batch by its modeled improvement over the best score already accepted in the session. One shared panel of 128 Student-t draws prices each candidate’s additional contribution to the best member already selected. This transfers the earlier incumbent-greedy construction to the completed Student-t host. It changes allocation utility alone; the separately registered Gaussian-shape direction is not included. The earlier Gaussian-host loss and useful zero-utility purchases make endpoint conversion an open, falsifiable question.

hypothesis: Change only the selected-batch objective on the actual fixed-nu3 Student-t Parent. At suggestion entry freeze b_inc as the largest raw score among all actually accepted current-session initial and optimizer records. Let F be a single immutable 128-by-P panel from the original conditional latent Student-t law, with the inherited ten normal/radial rows kept exactly as its first ten rows. For a selected set S, U(S)=mean_r(max(b_inc,max_{i in S} F[r,i])-b_inc), U(empty)=0. Initialize h_r=b_inc and availability to the original K3/M40 eligibility mask. At each announced position compute g_i=mean_r(max(F[r,i]-h_r,0)) in float64, choose the available identity of greatest g_i with smallest original pool index on every exact tie, update h_r=max(h_r,F[r,i]), and remove only that identity. Run the announced ten positions. Each row shares one inverse-Gamma multiplier across the entire correlated pool; the panel is never re-fit, conditioned, resampled or changed within the batch. The retained mean, conditional covariance, count geometry, normalization, noise, gate and generator are not re-estimated or retuned. New purchases feed only their real accepted scores through the existing archive/survival/breeding loop. The hypothesized path is changed paid allocation followed by useful accepted feedback and improved endpoint; sampled utility, calibration, ancestry and local gain are not asserted mediators.

finding_summary.headline: Greedy utility changes every batch but misses the registered endpoint gain.
finding_summary.insights: The registered host-specific consumer prediction is refuted after complete, materially exposed execution. Increasing modeled batch utility did not deliver the required endpoint gain or larger real parent-beating advances. The incumbent-utility construction operated as registered, including its finite-batch adaptation, but neither the literature source nor the donor supplies an efficacy guarantee. Same-paid TP predictive loss remained lower than the Gaussian diagnostic in every cell, while the predictive mean and its ordering were unchanged on each state. Across the actual Child purchases, strict mean-versus-label ordering accuracy was 70.24%; that identifies a remaining ranking limitation without proving it caused the outcome. Twenty-two sampled-zero choices produced one parent-beating gain and eleven later-used parents, but no incumbent win; the older donor’s fourteen zero-utility incumbent wins remain an explicit finite-panel warning under its original conditions. The molecular report shows both increased pooled scaffold coverage and uneven family concentration, plus larger size tails and unresolved stereochemistry. It therefore supports neither universal scaffold collapse nor a chemical explanation for the endpoint change. Predictive-location or ranking models and proposal/search schemes remain distinct capability classes to investigate; these data select no particular replacement. The observed allocation effect is below the supplied material-effect scale, without establishing population equivalence, mediation or the contributions of retained components.
finding_summary.results: All 435 conditional laws and 4,350 exact greedy choices completed correctly. Every purchase set changed, with 2,583 actually accepted molecules absent from the original TP rule on the same state. Mean sampled batch utility rose from 0.0214373 to 0.0284898: 434 pools improved, one tied and none declined. Yet the complete macro score was 0.57239489 versus 0.57280205 for the code Parent, a change of −0.00040716 against the registered +0.002 prediction. Seed changes were +0.03906739, −0.02424257 and −0.01604630; nine task/seed cells gained and six lost. The largest positive cell supplied 60.1% of positive gain mass, while substantial losses elsewhere nearly cancelled it. Full generating-parent gain fell from 14.4408 to 13.8011 and late gain from 4.8820 to 3.9309. All available 4,200 next-fit joins succeeded and 150 terminal purchases remain censored. The separate formal-Anchor numerical deficit was 0.03463542. Its unchanged global criterion cannot be attained by this Child because the literal code-Parent condition differs. Paired task safety passes against the code Parent and fails against the formal Anchor; no protocol flag or Anchor selection is changed.

molecular.headline: Ring-rich families retain undefined stereochemistry and sensitive bond motifs; the large-molecule tail grows unevenly across sessions.
molecular.overall_character: All fifteen trusted Child Search trajectories for n-645c611d69c8 and all fifteen archived trajectories for its code Parent n-c34780421617 were read, covering the five issued tasks and seeds 0,1,2. Each original evaluator summary and all thirty task entries report ok; every trajectory contains evaluations 1..300, ten initial records and 290 accepted optimizer records with unique recorded identities. Each node therefore contributes 150 initial record occurrences and 4350 optimizer record occurrences. The same ten initial structures recur across all thirty sessions and are kept separate from generated proposals. The late population is exactly 2175 optimizer records per node, ordinals 146..290 inclusive, equivalently evaluations 156..300. The frozen comparison independently declares child_complete=true and paired_complete=true, matched seeds [0,1,2], with no profile mismatches; no trajectory, task, seed or molecular population is missing. This establishes complete observed chemistry and descriptive Parent pairing, without deciding model execution or mechanism activation. RDKit 2023.09.6 parses all 9000 saved records. Among Child optimizer records, 4150/4350 have a perceived ring and 3843/4350 an aromatic atom, versus Parent 4171/4350 and 3979/4350. The digest separately reports per-task ring-closure text rates 0.9069..0.9805 and aromatic-text rates 0.5736..0.9736; these are SMILES-string occurrence counters, not perceived ring counts or aromatic-atom fractions. Aromatic and partially saturated heterocycles, carbonyl-to-nitrogen groups, amines, ethers and halogen substituents coexist with tiny molecules, very large decorated assemblies, N/O-halogen bonds, peroxides, cumulenes and complex fused or bridged rings. The qualitative quality chips describe this mixture; synthesis, stability, ADME and biological utility were not measured. Heavy-atom quantiles (minimum, 10%, 25%, median, 75%, 90%, maximum) are Child 1,23,25,29,35,49,115 and Parent 1,23,26,30,33.75,40,120. Four inherited thresholds remain separate: counts at <=5, <=6, >=50 and >50 are Child 189,202,433,410 and Parent 162,177,298,291. The late counts under those same thresholds are Child 68,69,264,250 and Parent 66,73,138,135. Initial occurrences range from six to thirty-nine heavy atoms, with fifteen at <=6 and none at <=5 or >=50. Thus the larger full-panel small tail does not imply a larger late small tail. All 250 Child late records >50 occur in one task, whose seed-specific concentrations are described below. Graph queries find N-halogen, O-halogen and peroxide motifs in 287,318,228 Child proposals versus 626,262,189 Parent proposals; categories overlap. Carbon-centred cumulated-double-bond motifs occur in 134 versus 37, and a carbon bearing multiple halogens in 197 versus 21. These are local structural flags, not uniform reactivity classes or proposed rejection rules. Neither node has any optimizer record with an assigned tetrahedral centre or an atom carrying formal charge, while 2873/4350 Child and 2453/4350 Parent records have at least one unassigned tetrahedral centre. Neutral representation does not establish solution protonation; unspecified configuration does not establish that material was made as a mixture. Small perceived rings of at most four atoms with every atom aromatic occur in 80 Child versus 184 Parent records; rings of at least nine atoms occur in 227 versus 316. No conformer or synthetic-route calculation establishes feasibility. Distinct nonempty typed/generic Bemis-Murcko scaffolds across optimizer records number Child 2129/1287 and Parent 1869/1222; empty acyclic scaffolds occur in 200 and 179 records and are excluded from those distinct-family counts. Typed scaffolds preserve atom/bond types, generic scaffolds use MakeScaffoldGeneric, and chirality is omitted. Broad pooled scaffold coverage coexists with concentration within particular high-label families. High and low deciles mean exactly 29 optimizer records per seed/task, ordered by saved score with evaluation-order ties, then pooled to 87 per task; these are descriptions of existing labels, not a new selection rule or an algorithm ranking. All fifteen cell audits retain initial, full, late, high and low populations, both size tails, scaffold coverage and similarity before/after excluding <=6-heavy-atom records. Similarity uses unhashed radius-two Morgan count fingerprints, no chirality or feature invariants, and RDKit sparse-count Tanimoto over every unordered distinct-record pair within one cell. Each full cell has 290 records and 41905 pairs. After the diagnostic size exclusion, Child cells have 252..285 records and 31626..40470 pairs; Parent cells have 259..289 records and 33411..41616 pairs. Cell mean similarities range from 0.195205..0.391475 before exclusion and 0.250960..0.407644 after exclusion in the Child, versus 0.230300..0.379897 and 0.269097..0.383398 in the Parent. These are ranges over cells, not pooled cross-session similarity or uncertainty intervals. The accepted trajectories and summaries used here do not encode the prospective same-state reference sets or utility masks. Changed-versus-shared purchases, mask regimes and sampled-zero utility strata are therefore not assigned by this molecular audit; those logs are outside this report's inspected molecular inputs, not asserted absent from the node. No counterfactual molecular endpoint or causal mediator is inferred. The records also do not identify a missing target-required pharmacophore. Source conditions for every gap below are this finite Search panel, current-session accepted observations and this specific Child/code-Parent pairing. method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
